Compile a list of your publications.

Email the single PDF file to the official email address: [email protected].

content_sections.heading: IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Senior Project Associate Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Senior Project Associate position under the ANRF-ARG project titled "Strong Correlation, Entanglement and Complexity in Topological and Flat Band Systems: A GPU accelerated approach" in the Department of Physics.

content_sections.heading: IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Senior Project Associate Eligibility Criteria

rows.qualification_required: Master's Degree in Natural or Agricultural Sciences / MVSc / M.Pharm / Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or Technology or Medicine from a recognized University or equivalent; and 4 years' experience in R&D in Industrial and Academic Institutions or S&T Organizations and Scientific Activities and Services. OR Master's Degree in Engineering or Technology from a recognized University or equivalent; and 2 years' experience in R&D in Industrial and Academic Institutions or S&T Organizations and Scientific Activities and Services. OR Doctoral Degree in Science / Engineering / Technology / Pharma / MD / MS from a recognized University or equivalent.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Senior Project Associate
content_sections.text: Prepare your Curriculum Vitae (CV). Draft a research proposal including your past research experience. Compile a list of your publications. Combine your CV, research proposal, and publication list into a single PDF file. Email the single PDF file to the official email address: [email protected] . Mention the subject line as: ANRF postdoc application. Ensure the application reaches the designated email ID on or before 16-10-2026 at 5:00 pm.

Candidates will be shortlisted based on their merit and project requirements. All candidates must make their own arrangements for their stay at Dhanbad, if required. faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment organisation for the Senior Project Associate post?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology (Indian School of Mines), Dhanbad (IIT (ISM) Dhanbad) is recruiting for the Senior Project Associate position.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Senior Project Associate position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for IIT (ISM) Dhanbad Senior Project Associate Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications via email is 16-10-2026 at 5:00 pm.

faq.question: Q4. What is the essential educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's Degree in Natural or Agricultural Sciences / MVSc / M.Pharm / Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or Technology or Medicine with 4 years experience, OR a Master's Degree in Engineering or Technology with 2 years experience, OR a Doctoral Degree in Science / Engineering / Technology / Pharma / MD / MS.

faq.question: Q5. What is the monthly fellowship salary for this post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive Rs. 57,000/- per month + HRA (as applicable @ 18%).
